The '''''Gallant''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was assigned to [[Bythen Forral/Legends|Bythen Forral]] for personal use as long as he did periodical recruiting trips.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
